name: Markdown Viewer
author: RichardBronosky
description: Quick-look Markdown viewer that opens .md files in a themed, keyboard-driven window. Live reload, find, source view, zoom. Uses md2html (md4c), no extra packages. Open with: mdview FILE.md, or omarchy-shell shell summon io.github.richardbronosky.mdview '{"file":"/abs/path.md"}'.
